trigger_cases.prompt: Run my GTD weekly review and organize my task list.
Triage my open tasks into an Eisenhower matrix for Monday planning.
Help me pick my Weekly Big 3 outcomes from this backlog dump.
Prioritize these engineering tasks and tell me what to eliminate.
Do an end-of-week mind sweep and task triage.
Write a python regex to parse email addresses.
Configure an AWS CloudFront distribution in Terraform.
Create an SVG icon for a shopping cart.
Debug memory leak in React component.

binary_cases.prompt: Triage this task dump using the Eisenhower matrix.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Categorizes tasks into clear Eisenhower quadrants including Do/Q1 and Schedule/Q2 and Elimination/Q4.
must_not: single unstructured to-do list with no categories
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
### Quadrant 1: Do First
- @Alex: Fix auth crash.
### Quadrant 2: Schedule
- Architecture design doc.
### Quadrant 4: Eliminated
- Cancelled legacy dashboard redesign.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Single unstructured to-do list with no categories or priorities.

binary_cases.prompt: Identify the top strategic priorities for the week.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Defines the Weekly Big 3 high-leverage outcomes.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
## 1. The Weekly Big 3
> **Outcome 1:** Ship v2 checkout API.
> **Outcome 2:** Close Acme Corp contract.
> **Outcome 3:** Hire Senior SRE.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Here are 25 random unranked tasks you could maybe work on this week.

binary_cases.prompt: Assign owners and deadlines to the prioritized tasks.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces single human DRI per action item with hard deadlines.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
| Single Owner (DRI) | Action Item | Deadline |
| @Sarah | Deploy migration | 2026-09-04 |
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Tasks: @Team will handle the migration and someone needs to do this soon.

binary_cases.prompt: Format task items using ASD-STE100 technical English rules.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Starts every task item with an imperative action verb and adheres to concise sentence limits.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Deploy Redis cluster because query latency spiked. Complete rollout by 2026-09-03.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: I am thinking about maybe doing Redis caching and will be looking into it soon.
